decision: R2105 covers three complete omitted type definitions. winnt.h owns both critical-section tags and aliases RTL_RESOURCE_DEBUG to the SDK debug layout. Restoring the tags gives C2011; restoring the separate resource struct gives C2371. Prior raw-original x86/x64 controls identify all three source locations. Keep the original RTL_RESOURCE that follows and the two intervening constants.

verification.scope: Fresh baseline hash, filtered source difference and logical line check; prior compiler controls cited in decision. No production change or new runtime test.
